note: Renames exact UUIDs to a hits map carrying matched fields and drops ORDER BY from the count; the OR group and ordering are still built inline in list, no helper extracted.
Passes exact_hits into _person_list_response, which still recomputes the CSV check from accepted_renderer.format; is_csv_request is not passed through.
Moves member filtering, pagination and editable-id computation into a memberListFor selector in notificationGovernanceLogic; the component just reads it.
Replaces the shared assignment epoch Arc with per-partition generations in the ledger; forget bumps generation and replaces the ledger; staleness is stamp < generation.
Replaces manual regional client capture/shutdown with the ph_scoped_capture context manager in the sweep report activity.
Removes the two thin wrapper components; SubscriptionDestinationCell now takes a destination directly and callers compute it.
Moves regex compilation onto the parsed config; the labeled rules loop with continue 'rules remains, no rule_targets helper extracted.
Adds feature_flags/backend/realtime_targeting.py with a public gate function; cohort.py imports it at top level and drops both function-body imports.
Extracts a shared ScoutCreateModalHost and disabled-reason hook used by both ScoutCreateButton and the template modal, instead of adding an open-state prop.
ShadowOutcome::Failed now wraps BuildFailure; adds BuildFailure::from_live_read for the live-read categories and an as_label mapping.
Adds an error_message_contains server-side filter to the invocation results API and uses it with limit 1 instead of client-side filtering of 500 rows.
Drops the separate chunk-stats event and folds total_chunks and chunks_skipped into the existing upload started event.
Adds config validation, depth caps and input limits; the key-name based unit interval set remains, no per-field min/max range introduced.
Defines _MALFORMED_DEFINITION_ERRORS at module level and uses it in both the cohort and flag except clauses.
Only rewords the catalog tool description about feature availability; the tool name stays billing-catalog-get.
Moves PI_RUNTIME from previewConfig.ts into the shared package's agent-runtime module and imports it from @posthog/shared.
Adds an exported waitlistSurveyId helper in the logic and uses it in the listener, the render and the sorter.
Exporter looks up a registered handler per export format via an exports facade registry; the product registers its JSONL handler in its app config.
Adds a key_list helper in clickhouse/sql.rs and uses it in key_presence_predicate instead of the inline literal join.
Sets the Redis TTL constant equal to the debounce constant instead of a separate literal.
